redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages or metadata used as validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution or public-serving rights.
An exact official open resource whose licence, attribution, version, schema, coverage, CRS and digest are pinned.
Unclear-rights or non-geospatial evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: Current GOV.UK pages establish Dhekelia as BFPO 58 with shadow postcode BF1 2AU and instruct senders to use the BFPO number rather than a town or country. OGL v3 permits reuse of GOV.UK content subject to its terms, but these route/format pages contain no postal area geometry.

The current six-sheet workbook contains exact Dhekelia-related assignment rows for 6370 and 7502 but no coordinate, CRS, WKT, GeoJSON, Polygon or MultiPolygon field. The public page displays a 2026 copyright notice and no resource-specific AGID-compatible processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving grant or immutable release URL was established.

The 2015 official PDF confirms the Dhekelia Area Office postal address uses BFPO 58. It concerns Special Areas of Conservation; its attached environmental-map context is not postal geometry, it is stale for the current denominator, and no resource-specific public-serving right was established.

Current OGL GOV.UK material identifies Dhekelia within the Sovereign Base Areas and the separate SBA Administration. This administrative context prevents identity merging; it never supplies a postcode perimeter.

artifact_partitions.rule: BFPO 58, BF1 2AU, eligibility and routing retain MOD provenance and explicit non-area semantics unless postal authority supplies area geometry.
6370 and 7502 retain Cyprus Post provenance and are not silently assigned to XD merely from text or containment.
Only separately reviewed rights-cleared Polygon/MultiPolygon with complete dual-system reconciliation may be public output.
XD, Cyprus, Akrotiri, Episkopi, Ayios Nikolaos and combined SBA context remain distinct administrative identity evidence.
Addresses, streets, communities, offices and buildings remain separate and are not buffered into geometry.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
